themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe are intensifying demands for policies that prioritize citizens over immigrants in access to social services, housing, and employment. This theme has seen strong convergence, particularly in Spain, Italy, and Norway, where such policies are being formalized in regional governance agreements or legislative proposals.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Proposes 'national priority' in social aid, housing, and employment in regional agreements with PP in Castilla y León, Extremadura, and Aragón.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Advocates for prioritizing Italian citizens in social services and housing, with regional implementations in coalition agreements.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Promotes policies favoring Norwegian citizens in welfare and housing, reflected in local governance proposals.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Calls for 'national preference' in social benefits and employment, gaining traction in local elections.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Demands stricter immigration controls and prioritization of British citizens in social services and housing.

themes.title: Javier Milei’s declining approval amid internal strife
themes.blurb: Argentina's President Javier Milei faces growing internal divisions within his party, La Libertad Avanza, alongside declining public approval. These tensions are exacerbated by disputes over judicial appointments, economic policies, and leadership dynamics, with figures like Patricia Bullrich and Karina Milei challenging his authority.

themes.title: Far-right gains in European local elections
themes.blurb: Far-right parties are making significant electoral gains in local and regional elections across Europe, particularly in Germany, Italy, Spain, and Sweden. These victories are reshaping local governance and influencing national political debates, often through coalition agreements with center-right parties.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Gains in Saxony-Anhalt and other regional elections, positioning itself as a leading opposition force.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Strengthens its position in local elections, forming coalitions with center-right parties in key regions.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Secures influence in regional governments through coalition agreements with PP in Castilla y León, Extremadura, and Aragón.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Increases its share of local council seats, influencing municipal policies on immigration and welfare.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Wins control of local councils, including Calderdale, and gains traction in by-elections.

themes.title: Internal divisions within far-right parties
themes.blurb: Far-right parties across multiple countries are experiencing internal fractures, with leadership challenges, ideological disputes, and public disagreements over policy directions. These divisions are often centered around figures like Javier Milei in Argentina, Matteo Salvini in Italy, and Nigel Farage in the UK.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Experiences post-election tensions between Fidesz and the emerging Tisza Party, with disputes over EU funds and governance.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Struggles with leadership challenges and internal disagreements over policy stances, particularly on immigration.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Faces tensions between Marine Le Pen and Jordan Bardella over leadership succession and policy direction.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Internal conflicts between Javier Milei, Patricia Bullrich, and Karina Milei over judicial appointments and economic policies.

themes.title: Far-right reactions to Middle East conflicts
themes.blurb: Far-right parties and leaders are increasingly framing their responses to Middle East conflicts through the lens of immigration, national security, and cultural identity. This theme is particularly prominent in the U.S., Argentina, Italy, Poland, and France, where far-right figures are leveraging these conflicts to advance anti-immigration and nationalist agendas.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Focuses on Iran and Israel, framing conflicts as existential threats to U.S. security and advocating for strong military responses.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Aligns with pro-Israel and pro-U.S. stances, criticizing leftist ties to Middle Eastern regimes.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Supports Israel and advocates for stronger EU action against Iran, framing conflicts as threats to European security.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Criticizes Iran and supports Israel, using conflicts to justify stricter immigration policies.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Opposes immigration from Middle Eastern conflict zones, framing it as a threat to French identity and security.
